show.description: Ultimate Dangal is a gripping tale of fallen champion Bajrang Pandey, once hailed as “King,” who now lives in the shadows of his broken past. When his fiery daughter Yuvika Pandey steps into the brutal MMA world against ruthless fighters like Garima “The Shark” Sharma and the cold-blooded champion Kaali, Bajrang must confront his own demons and rediscover his legacy. Watch Now!
